'''Nicanas Tassu''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] serving the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
[[File:Nicanas_Tassu_TLC.jpg|thumb|left|150px|Nicanas Tassu]]
Discovered to be [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] during infancy, Nicanas Tassu was taken to the [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] for [[Jedi training/Legends|training]] in the ways of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. Eventually [[Initiate Trials/Legends|graduating]] from the [[Jedi academy|Temple's academy]], Tassu was selected to be a [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] by a [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]]. After years of study and having constructed a green-bladed [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] for himself, Tassu went on to pass his [[Jedi Trials/Legends|Trials of Knighthood]] and was given the rank of [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]]<ref name="SWFC">''[[Star Wars: Force Collection]]''</ref> by the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]].

In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], Jedi Tassu was stationed at the Temple when [[Master of the Order/Legends|Master of the Order]] [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] rallied all available Jedi to join a [[Jedi assault team/Legends|strike team]] to free the captured Jedi [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], and [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] from execution by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. Arriving on the dusty plains of the foundry world, Jedi Tassu aided in storming the [[Petranaki arena]] with his comrades in order to free the prisoners. Armed with an extra lightsaber, Tassu was assigned to arm the two captured Jedi with the help of fellow Jedi [[Sephjet Josall/Legends|Sephjet Josall]]. Rushing the arena floor, Josall and Tassu were able to pass on their spare weapons.<ref name="SWI77" />

==Behind the scenes==
Although his [[Death/Legends|death]] in the Battle of Geonosis was not officially confirmed, Holocron Keeper [[Leland Chee]] listed him among Jedi who fought in the Battle who fates were unknown but likely dead in a [[2005]] [[Star Wars: Blogs]] post.<ref name="Chee">{{Blog|holocron|10|Jedi Casualties: Battle of Geonosis}}</ref>
